incidents.name: VUN public _swap arbitrary router call
incidents.notes: VUN's internal _swap(address,bytes) was left public, so any caller could make the vault execute an arbitrary 1inch unoswapTo call and route the vault's ALP_APO holdings to itself before redeeming them.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xD188492217F09D18f2B0ecE3F8948015981e961a created 2023-12-19T03:01:30Z by 0x78000b0605e81ea9df54b33f72ebc61b5f5c8077, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xff61ba33ed51322bb716eab4137adf985644b94d; 1 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from last of 1 upgrade events (onchain).
